description: Integrates the expression search box into the quick filter bar of Thunderbird's mail tabs and registers the custom search terms.

functions.name: setOptions
functions.description: Starts the integration on first call and applies the given options. Unknown keys are ignored.

functions.name: searchFromMessage
functions.description: Searches the given mail tab for messages that share a field with the given message (click-to-search).

functions.name: getLegacyPrefs
functions.description: Returns the settings of Expression Search 2.x (extensions.expressionsearch.* preferences) converted to the current option names, or null if there are none.

functions.name: getCustomDBHeaders
functions.description: Returns the extra headers Thunderbird stores in its message database (mailnews.customDBHeaders), needed for the headerre: operator.

functions.name: setCustomDBHeaders
functions.description: Sets mailnews.customDBHeaders. Only header names (letters, digits, '-') separated by spaces are accepted.

events.name: onCommand
events.description: Fired when the user requests something that the background page handles, e.g. opening the help page.
